tasks.title: topWords in src/steps.js
tasks.description: Rank the words of a count table.

context.reason: the test that decides whether this task worked

edits.change: Replace the stub with topWords(counts, limit): counts is an object of word to count, and the result is an array of [word, count] pairs sorted by count from highest to lowest, cut to at most limit pairs, where words with the same count stay in the order their keys first appear in counts. So topWords({ a: 2, b: 1, c: 3 }, 2) is [['c', 3], ['a', 2]], topWords({ a: 1, b: 1 }, 2) is [['a', 1], ['b', 1]] and topWords({}, 2) is []. Throw a TypeError when limit is not an integer and a RangeError when limit is below 1. Leave splitWords, joinWords and reportLine exactly as they are.
